subtitle: Warcraft Research — Equipment & Talent Handoff
changes: Added a Warcraft Equipment Research Board inside Live Armory that cross-references source-returned equipped item IDs with personal Item Atlas, Loot Hunter and character-target records.

Added quick search and filters for equipped items already saved in Item Atlas, tracked in Loot Hunter, assigned to the looked-up character, or not personally tracked, with a responsive 16-record incremental display.
Enabled explicit player-initiated Track Goal handoff into the existing Loot Hunter system, and direct official item ID research in the existing Item Codex.
Added a clearly separated read-only Talent Forge summary of manually planned point totals, never confusing them with the loaded character's confirmed in-game talents.
No new Blizzard network requests, authentication changes, saved-data migration, music or Founder changes. Live player and device testing remains outstanding.
